filtered.title: No invoices match these filters
filtered.body: Change the carrier or date range and try again.

none.title: No invoices uploaded yet
none.body: Upload FedEx, UPS, DHL, Aras, Yurtiçi, MNG or PTT invoices as CSV/XLSX, or have AI read a PDF. Columns are mapped automatically, and every line is checked against your measurements and tariff.

search.title: No invoices match
search.body: Check the invoice or tracking number.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{no}}?
deleteDialog.body: The invoice leaves the list; the invoice, its lines and your line decisions are permanently deleted after 30 days. Deleting cannot be undone. An invoice with a dispute record is kept. You can upload the same file again later.

demo.uploadBlocked: The sample-data demo is on. End the demo before uploading your own invoice.
